cover_sub: Explore key financial trends affecting nonprofits today.

slides.label: Operating Reserves
slides.headline: 40% of nonprofits have less than 3 months of reserves.
slides.body: Many nonprofits operate on thin margins, with only a few months of funds to cover expenses. This highlights the importance of financial planning and sustainability.

slides.label: Small Organizations
slides.headline: Small orgs invest directly in programs.
slides.body: Organizations with budgets under $500K often have lean reserves but are not necessarily struggling. They prioritize program funding over reserves.

slides.label: Nonprofit Growth
slides.headline: Sector grows, but funding per org declines.
slides.body: Despite a 10% increase in nonprofits, revenue per organization has dropped by 3%, indicating a need for smarter funding strategies.

slides.label: Funding Paradox
slides.headline: More nonprofits, less funding per org.
slides.body: The funding paradox shows that while the number of nonprofits has grown, the funding available per organization has decreased, affecting financial stability.

slides.label: Small Org Trends
slides.headline: Small organizations are getting smaller.
slides.body: Funding dynamics are causing small nonprofits to shrink further, impacting their ability to serve communities effectively.

slides.label: Impactful Funding
slides.headline: Daanaa shows where capital makes a real difference.
slides.body: Daanaa helps funders understand where their capital will have the most significant impact, ensuring resources are directed effectively.
